**`test_close_record_unwritable_ticket_stays_open`** (`tests/acceptance/W1-30/test_w1_30_close.py:647`):
The test creates a file at `docs/close/blocker` and expects the close record write to fail. But the close record path is `docs/close/PROJ-aaaa/CL-PROJ-aaaa.md` — the `mkdir(parents=True)` for `docs/close/PROJ-aaaa/` succeeds because `docs/close/blocker` (a file) is a sibling, not a conflict. For the test to work as intended, the blocker should be at `docs/close/PROJ-aaaa` (a file at the ticket's subdirectory path), which would prevent directory creation. My unit test `test_write_close_record.py::test_oserror_propagates` confirms this mechanism works with the correct blocker placement.
